TelegramBot.help:
Mikka Telegram commands:
/new <title> — start a task draft
Send details, then /confirm to create it in Backlog
/cancel — discard the draft
/issues — list recent tasks
/link ORV-123 or /link <issue UUID> — link this chat to a task
/status — show the linked task
/unlink — clear the link
